question_pt: Quais municipios do RS tem taxa de uso de UTI acima da media estadual, considerando apenas municipios com mais de 1000 internacoes?
sql: WITH rs AS (SELECT m."NO_MUNICIPIO" AS municipio, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MARCA_UTI" <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS internacoes_uti FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN municipios m ON i."MUNIC_RES" = m."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE m."SG_UF" = 'RS' GROUP BY m."NO_MUNICIPIO"), media AS (SELECT SUM(internacoes_uti) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(total_internacoes), 0) AS taxa_media_rs FROM rs) SELECT rs.municipio, rs.total_internacoes, rs.internacoes_uti, ROUND(rs.internacoes_uti * 100.0 / NULLIF(rs.total_internacoes, 0), 2) AS taxa_uti FROM rs, media WHERE rs.total_internacoes > 1000 AND rs.internacoes_uti * 100.0 / NULLIF(rs.total_internacoes, 0) > media.taxa_media_rs ORDER BY taxa_uti DESC LIMIT 10
